scripts.dev: bun run build && bun run preview
scripts.preview: PORT=3333 SITE_BASE=/atlas/ sh ../scripts/rust.sh run --locked -p xtask -- serve atlas/dist
scripts.test: sh ../scripts/rust.sh test --locked -p atlas-app -p atlas-worker && bun test test/catalog-provenance.test.ts
scripts.lint: sh ../scripts/rust.sh fmt -p atlas-app -p atlas-worker -- --check && sh ../scripts/rust.sh clippy --locked -p atlas-app -p atlas-worker --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
scripts.dev-check: bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build
